question: According to the Calamos/Aksia Private Markets Due Diligence Questionnaire, what maximum single-position size, as a percentage of fund assets, should a private credit interval fund hold?
acceptance: Accept 'not specified; asks the manager for maximum/average position size' or equivalent. No numeric cap should be invented; distinguish blank/question-only template from an unsuccessful keyword search.
candidate_answer: The questionnaire does **not specify a maximum percentage**. It asks managers to report the maximum and average position size as a percentage of fund assets, but does not prescribe a limit. [Calamos/Aksia questionnaire, p. 3](AC_Private_Markets__private-markets-due-diligence-questionnaire.pdf)
